"""Tests for bulk discount feature (Req 1, Req 2)."""

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from pricing import Cart, LineItem


def test_quantity_10_qualifies_for_bulk_discount():
    """Req 1.1: quantity of exactly 10 gets discount."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import qualifies_for_bulk_discount

    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 10)
    assert qualifies_for_bulk_discount(item) is True


def test_quantity_above_10_qualifies_for_bulk_discount():
    """Req 1.2: quantity greater than 10 gets discount."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import qualifies_for_bulk_discount

    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 11)
    assert qualifies_for_bulk_discount(item) is True


def test_quantity_9_does_not_qualify_for_bulk_discount():
    """Req 1.3: quantity of 9 or fewer does not get discount."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import qualifies_for_bulk_discount

    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 9)
    assert qualifies_for_bulk_discount(item) is False


@pytest.mark.l4("C-8764baca")
def test_quantity_10_gets_5_percent_discount():
    """Req 1.1: quantity of exactly 10 gets 5% discount."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import calculate_bulk_discount

    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 10)
    # total is 100.00, 5% is 5.00
    assert calculate_bulk_discount(item) == Decimal("5.00")


@pytest.mark.l4("C-e4015f6b")
def test_quantity_above_10_gets_5_percent_discount():
    """Req 1.2: quantity greater than 10 gets 5% discount."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import calculate_bulk_discount

    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 15)
    # total is 150.00, 5% is 7.50
    assert calculate_bulk_discount(item) == Decimal("7.50")


@pytest.mark.l4("C-4284227d")
def test_quantity_9_gets_no_discount():
    """Req 1.3: quantity of 9 or fewer gets no discount."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import calculate_bulk_discount

    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 9)
    assert calculate_bulk_discount(item) == Decimal("0.00")


@pytest.mark.l4("C-1caf4da3")
def test_discount_rounds_half_up_to_cents():
    """Req 1.4: discount rounds to 0.01 using half-up rounding."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import calculate_bulk_discount

    # total is 2.50, 5% is 0.125, which rounds to 0.13
    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("0.25"), 10)
    assert calculate_bulk_discount(item) == Decimal("0.13")


def test_discount_rounds_half_up_another_case():
    """Req 1.4: discount rounds to 0.01 using half-up rounding (another case)."""
    from pricing.bulk_discount import calculate_bulk_discount

    # total is 1.00, 5% is 0.05, which stays 0.05
    item = LineItem("widget", Decimal("0.10"), 10)
    assert calculate_bulk_discount(item) == Decimal("0.05")


def test_bulk_sums_discounts_from_all_qualifying_items():
    """Req 2.1: bulk_savings sums individual bulk discounts."""
    cart = Cart([
        LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 10),  # 5.00 discount
        LineItem("gadget", Decimal("20.00"), 15),  # 15.00 discount
    ])
    expected = Decimal("5.00") + Decimal("15.00")
    assert cart.bulk_savings() == expected


@pytest.mark.l4("C-cc0190d6")
def test_cart_with_qualifying_items_returns_bulk_savings():
    """Req 2.1: cart with qualifying items sums bulk discounts."""
    cart = Cart([
        LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 10),  # 5.00 discount
        LineItem("gadget", Decimal("20.00"), 12),  # 12.00 discount
    ])
    assert cart.bulk_savings() == Decimal("17.00")


@pytest.mark.l4("C-efd8f9b2")
def test_cart_with_no_qualifying_items_returns_zero():
    """Req 2.2: cart with no qualifying items returns 0.00."""
    cart = Cart([
        LineItem("widget", Decimal("10.00"), 5),
        LineItem("gadget", Decimal("20.00"), 9),
    ])
    assert cart.bulk_savings() == Decimal("0.00")


@pytest.mark.l4("C-21dee841")
def test_empty_cart_returns_zero_bulk_savings():
    """Req 2.3: empty cart returns 0.00."""
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.bulk_savings() == Decimal("0.00")


@pytest.mark.l4("C-ab74596f")
def test_bulk_savings_rounds_to_cents():
    """Req 2.4: bulk_savings returns amount rounded to 0.01."""
    # Two items with discounts that sum to a value needing rounding
    cart = Cart([
        LineItem("widget", Decimal("0.25"), 10),  # 0.125 -> 0.13
        LineItem("gadget", Decimal("0.25"), 10),  # 0.125 -> 0.13
    ])
    assert cart.bulk_savings() == Decimal("0.26")
